description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and facility management within a supportive environment.The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the facility's operations, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and fostering a positive and productive atmosphere for both staff and residents. This role requires a visionary leader committed to maintaining high standards of quality care and operational excellence.This full-time position offers a competitive salary range, commensurate with experience and qualifications. Join a team dedicated to providing exceptional care and achieving outstanding outcomes.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Proven track record of successful facility management, including financial oversight and regulatory compliance.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $115,000 - $145,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA, as a Registered Nurse (RN) MDS Coordinator. This vital full-time role involves overseeing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process, ensuring accurate and timely assessments that are crucial for resident care planning and facility reimbursement. You will play a key part in maintaining compliance with federal and state regulations, contributing significantly to the quality of care provided to our residents.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced RN MDS Coordinator who is passionate about resident advocacy and regulatory compliance. This position offers a competitive annual salary of $65,000 - $75,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment. If you are looking for a challenging yet rewarding opportunity to utilize your clinical assessment and organizational skills in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply.

This is a full-time opportunity, and we are looking for a long-term commitment to our team and residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa or a compact state
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) and the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process
Proficient knowledge of federal and state regulations pertaining to long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
